faq.a_few_useful_details_to_help_you: A few useful details to help you prepare for your consultation.
faq.what_are_the_common_signs_of_type_2: What are the common signs of type 2 diabetes?
faq.frequent_urination_excess_thirst_unexpla: Frequent urination, excess thirst, unexplained weight loss, tiredness and slow healing wounds are common signs. Many people have no symptoms early, so a simple blood sugar test is the only way to know.
faq.how_is_high_blood_pressure_detected_and_: How is high blood pressure detected and managed?
faq.it_is_found_with_regular_blood_pressure_: It is found with regular blood pressure checks, as it often causes no symptoms. Management combines less salt, regular activity, weight control and medicines when needed.
faq.how_is_typhoid_spread_and_how_can_i: How is typhoid spread and how can I avoid it?
faq.typhoid_spreads_through_contaminated_foo: Typhoid spreads through contaminated food and water. Drink boiled or filtered water, eat freshly cooked food, wash hands and consider the typhoid vaccine.
faq.what_does_an_hba1c_test_show: What does an HbA1c test show?
faq.it_shows_your_average_blood_sugar_over_t: It shows your average blood sugar over the past 3 months. It helps diagnose diabetes and check if your treatment is working, without needing to fast.
faq.how_can_i_tell_if_my_tiredness_is: How can I tell if my tiredness is something more serious?
faq.tiredness_that_lasts_weeks_comes_with_we: Tiredness that lasts weeks, comes with weight change, pallor, breathlessness or low mood needs checking. Common causes include anaemia, thyroid problems, vitamin deficiency and diabetes.
faq.how_do_i_prevent_seasonal_infections_lik: How do I prevent seasonal infections like flu and viral fever?
faq.wash_hands_often_stay_hydrated_sleep_wel: Wash hands often, stay hydrated, sleep well and take the annual flu vaccine. Stay home and rest when unwell to avoid spreading infection.

privacy_policy.we_respect_patient_privacy_and_handle_pe: We respect patient privacy and handle personal information with care, transparency, and appropriate safeguards.
privacy_policy.this_privacy_policy_explains_how_persona: This Privacy Policy explains how personal information is collected, used, stored, and protected when you use this website and its consultation and appointment services.
privacy_policy.this_is_the_personal_microsite_of_doctor: This is the personal microsite of {{doctor_name}}, {{qualification}}, Registration No. To be configured. It is hosted on technology provided by DigiDr (digidr.app).
privacy_policy.doctor_name_decides_why_and_how_your: {{doctor_name}} decides why and how your details are used for your consultation and is the Data Fiduciary under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 ("DPDP Act"). DigiDr provides the technology and handles your details only on the doctor's instructions. DigiDr is not a healthcare provider.
privacy_policy.we_may_collect_the_following_categories_: We may collect the following categories of information:
privacy_policy.appointment_details_preferred_date_and_t: Appointment details (preferred date and time, reason for visit)
privacy_policy.documents_you_upload_through_forms_for_e: Documents you upload through forms (for example, reports and prescriptions)
privacy_policy.website_usage_data_browser_type_pages_vi: Website usage data (browser type, pages viewed, device and basic analytics)
privacy_policy.please_share_only_what_is_needed_for: Please share only what is needed for your visit. Do not upload government ID numbers or payment card details through the forms.
privacy_policy.3_how_we_use_your_information_and: 3) How We Use Your Information, and Your Consent
privacy_policy.respond_to_inquiries_and_provide_support: Respond to inquiries and provide support
privacy_policy.improve_the_website_using_anonymous_comb: Improve the website using anonymous, combined usage data
privacy_policy.meet_legal_medical_and_regulatory_obliga: Meet legal, medical, and regulatory obligations
privacy_policy.when_you_submit_a_booking_or_inquiry: When you submit a booking or inquiry form, you consent to your details being used to arrange and provide your consultation. You can withdraw your consent at any time by writing to us. Withdrawal does not affect use made before you withdrew, and we may keep records that the law requires. We send no promotional messages without your separate consent. Your submitted health details are never used to improve the website.
privacy_policy.we_treat_all_health_related_information_: We treat all health-related information with strict confidentiality. Any data shared through this website is handled with appropriate safeguards and is accessed only by authorised personnel as needed for care, administration, or legal compliance. DigiDr personnel can access it only where needed to run, secure, or support the service.
privacy_policy.where_health_education_on_this_site_is: Where health education on this site is drafted with AI, it is reviewed and approved by {{doctor_name}} before publication and labelled as AI-assisted. Details you submit in forms or documents are not used to create public content.
privacy_policy.we_do_not_sell_personal_data_and: We do not sell personal data and we do not use it for advertising. We may share information only when necessary with:
privacy_policy.authorised_staff_and_healthcare_professi: Authorised staff and healthcare professionals involved in your care
privacy_policy.service_providers_including_digidr_as_th: Service providers, including DigiDr as the technology provider, and hosting, appointment, or communication tools
privacy_policy.government_or_legal_authorities_when_req: Government or legal authorities when required by law
privacy_policy.where_a_service_provider_stores_data_out: Where a service provider stores data outside India, this is done in line with the DPDP Act.
privacy_policy.we_retain_personal_information_only_for_: We retain personal information only for as long as required to provide services, maintain records, and comply with applicable laws and medical record policies. When data is no longer needed and no law requires us to keep it, it is deleted or made anonymous.
privacy_policy.we_use_reasonable_technical_and_organisa: We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal information. However, no website or transmission method is completely secure, and absolute security cannot be guaranteed. If a personal data breach affects you, we will inform you and the Data Protection Board of India as the law requires.
privacy_policy.this_website_may_use_cookies_or_analytic: This website may use cookies or analytics tools to understand usage patterns and improve functionality. You can change your browser settings to control cookie preferences.
privacy_policy.under_the_dpdp_act_you_have_the: Under the DPDP Act, you have the right to:
privacy_policy.get_a_summary_of_the_personal_data: Get a summary of the personal data we hold about you
privacy_policy.ask_for_your_data_to_be_erased: Ask for your data to be erased
privacy_policy.nominate_another_person_to_exercise_your: Nominate another person to exercise your rights if you die or cannot act
privacy_policy.to_use_any_of_these_rights_write: To use any of these rights, write to {{doctor_name}} using the details below, or to DigiDr at {{email}}. If your grievance is not resolved, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
privacy_policy.if_the_patient_is_under_18_the: If the patient is under 18, the booking must be made by a parent or lawful guardian, who gives consent for the child. We do not track or target children with advertising.
privacy_policy.our_site_may_contain_links_to_third: Our site may contain links to third-party platforms. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of external sites and recommend reviewing their policies separately.
privacy_policy.we_may_update_this_privacy_policy_period: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. The latest version will always be posted on this page with the effective date. For changes that affect how your details are used, we will tell you where we hold your contact details.
privacy_policy.to_report_an_error_or_a_concern: To report an error or a concern about this site, or to raise a privacy grievance with DigiDr, write to {{email}}.
